name: IconInput
description:
A field that holds an icon's name: a box showing the chosen icon that opens an IconPicker in a
popover. Use it to let people give a category, asset type or list its own icon; store the name
and draw it with `iconCatalogue` (or a map of your own icons) where the item is shown.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, icons, placeholder, clearable, width, disabled, readOnly, invalid, required, name, id, onBlur, side, align, "aria-label": ariaLabel, className, ref, }: IconInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the overlay relative to its anchor.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Offer No icon in the picker, which clears the value. Default false.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The chosen icon when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: icons
props.description: The icons to offer. Default every icon (`iconCatalogue`).

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the chosen name with a native form.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the trigger, so a form can mark the field touched.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen name, or null when the person clears it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while no icon is chosen. Default "Choose an icon".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the anchor; collision handling may choose another side.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen icon's name, controlled; null for none.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short, medium (default) or full.
